verdict.rationale: Adyen documents ordering terminals from the Customer Area, with the Management API offered as the alternative to the dashboard (adyen-pos-docs-11). It also offers a standalone terminal option as 'the quickest way to accept in-person payments' (adyen-pos-docs-4) and terminal management from the unified Customer Area (adyen-pos-docs-3). However, nothing in the pack covers self-serve signup, underwriting or approval, or the speed of delivery and activation. missing for 10: self-serve founder signup flow, approval/onboarding timeline, evidence of hardware shipping and go-live within a week, independent or hands-on corroboration.
